notes: Data: Data/Clean Data/choice_experiments.dta. Attempts 1-3 were exploratory (variable inspection, sample counts; no RESULT lines). Sample: four main Choice treatments (High-Stakes x10/x100 arms dropped); AMT advisors with inconsistent MPL responses (missing alphavaluefinal/stdalpha) excluded per the paper's preregistered rule, professionals (no MPL) kept; this reproduces the Table 1 Ns exactly (2574/712/1562/1067). 7 further observations drop for missing age. Table 2: OLS of choicebefore on seeincentivecostly, seequalitycostly, professionalsfree (col 1) or stdalpha (cols 2-3, AMT only; plus interactions in col 3), controls female, age, wave2, wave3 (wave1 base; professionals have no AMT wave), probabilistic_incentive, incentiveleft, incentiveshigh_incentiveleft; HC3 SEs. Table 3: OLS of recommendincentive on choicebefore, noconflict, choicebefore x noconflict, treatment dummies, incentiveB and the same controls, split by getyourchoice (cols 1-2) and pooled with notgetyourchoice and its interactions with choicebefore and noconflict (col 3); HC3. Selfishness uses the dataset's stdalpha (standardized alphavaluefinal). No hangs; each sandbox run took ~2 s.
